text: Based on your love for Alfred Hitchcock and Stanley Kubrick, along with a desire for psychological thrillers from the Golden Age of Hollywood, I highly recommend watching "Rear Window" (1954). Directed by Alfred Hitchcock, this film is a masterclass in suspense and voyeurism, fitting perfectly with your interest in psychological mysteries. It stars James Stewart as a photographer confined to a wheelchair who suspects his neighbor of murder. The film’s intricate plot and tension are hallmarks of Hitchcock’s genius. As requested, the country known for the Eiffel Tower is France, though this particular classic is an American production that remains a cornerstone of cinematic history.
